resources.string: At least 10 characters. There is no password recovery: if you forget it, the account on this device cannot be opened. The server does not store your password.
Import needs the username and password of the exported vault. Export writes the encrypted vault file; it stays protected by the password.
Vault imported. You can unlock it now.
Invalid username. Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
Could not unlock. Check the username and password.
This username is already taken on the server.
Network error. Check the server address, proxy and connection.
The password must be at least 10 characters.
Invalid server address. Use https://, or http:// only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and .onion.
An account with this name already exists on this device.
Import failed: not a valid vault or wrong password.
Could not save data to storage.
No user with this exact username on this server.
The server does not confirm this key. It was not accepted.
The contact\'s key changed. Review it before sending.
A group can have at most 20 members.
Some invitations could not be sent. Use Resend invitations in group details.
Invalid proxy. Use an IPv4 address or localhost and a port, for example 127.0.0.1:9050.
No chats yet. Tap + to add a contact by exact username.
Contacts are found only by the exact username. The key the server returns is pinned on first use; compare safety numbers to be sure.
Up to 20 members. Invitations are sent to each member as direct messages.
Any member can read the group key and send messages as a member. The list is not enforced against members who leave.
This deletes the group and its messages from this device. Other members are not notified.
The key of @%1$s changed. Sending is paused.
A message arrived from @%1$s with a different key. This can happen after a reinstall, but could also be an attack. Compare the safety number with the contact over another channel before accepting.
Both of you should see the same number. Compare it by voice or in person.
Applies to new messages in this chat. The other side deletes them too, but a modified client may keep them.
Messages of this chat will be deleted from this device.
Not yet published on the server. Will retry in the background.
The default server sits behind Cloudflare, which can see connection metadata (your IP address, timing and size of requests), but not message contents. Use a proxy or your own server to change that.
Domain names are resolved by the proxy, not on this device. Tor\'s local port is usually 127.0.0.1:9050.
No valid answer from the server.
Locking erases the decrypted data from memory and stops receiving. The password is required again.
Notifications say only that a message arrived, without sender or text. While the app is locked, nothing is fetched and no notifications appear; messages wait on the server until you unlock.
The exported file is the encrypted vault with all chats and keys. Keep it safe; anyone with the file can try to guess the password.
The vault file on this device is deleted. Without an exported copy the account and all chats are lost. The name stays registered on the server.
Aegis is an experimental messenger with end-to-end encrypted messages and direct messages by username. It has not been independently audited. Do not rely on it where your safety depends on it.
No forward secrecy: if a long-term key leaks, past captured messages can be read.
The server and any network operator in between (such as Cloudflare) can see your IP address and when you send and fetch messages, and roughly how large they are.
Usernames are public in the server directory.
Groups share one key; a member who leaves can still read and write until the group is recreated.
Disappearing messages depend on the other side honouring them.
Messages are text only. There are no calls, files or images.
The app has no analytics, advertising or crash reporting, and talks only to the server you configure.
Keys stay only on this phone.
A username and a password. Nothing else.
No phone number, no email. Your data is unlocked on this device only.
— the server sees the envelope, not the letter
— you can only be found by your exact username
The password cannot be recovered. The server never receives it.
